notes: Official Tower portrait is front-facing and is composited on the right, matching the approved meadow pattern. The left side is reserved for a code-drawn hero (soft ground spot only). No friend characters are painted in. The background was rebuilt from the official hills scene renderer (bg + cooling rack only): continuous muffin-wrapper flutes and a complete rack grid, with no friend and no baked-in boss. Official front-facing Tower is composited on top at the locked-scene feet position. Anchor is the feet-center / ground contact. bbox is [x, y, w, h] in pixels of that orientation's faceoff image. Official front-facing cutout was re-composited with the contact-shadow-only alpha (ink smile / eyes / cheeks stay opaque).
